item.subject: science
item.stem:
Krish copies the feeding diagram shown below from a Class 8 field booklet.

Is the diagram a food chain or a food web, and why?

options.A: A food web, because more than one feeding path links the organisms.
options.B: A food chain, because any diagram with arrows between living things is called a food chain.
options.C: A food chain, because rice is drawn at the bottom so there can be only one sequence.
options.D: Neither, because the labels are organism names rather than the word producer or consumer.
